limitations_and_boundaries: Experiments performed in non-transformed human RPE-1 cells with p53 knockdown; may not fully represent in vivo conditions.
Single-cell MDA amplification introduces biases and may miss some rearrangements.
Only cells with micronuclear envelope rupture after S phase entry were selected; other mechanisms may exist.
Sample size limited to 9 experimental daughter pairs.
Rearrangement detection limited to events with at least two discordant read pairs and insert size >20 kb; smaller events may be missed.

experiments_or_tasks: Synchronization of RPE-1 cells by nocodazole release, siRNA-mediated knockdown of p53, single-cell sorting into 384-well plates, live-cell imaging to identify micronucleated cells with micronuclear envelope rupture after S phase entry, isolation of daughter cells after one division, whole-genome amplification by MDA, and sequencing.

methods.name: Look-Seq
methods.protocol_description: Live-cell imaging combined with single-cell genome sequencing. Cells expressing H2B-GFP and RFP-NLS are imaged to track micronucleus rupture and reincorporation. Daughter cells are separated, lysed, and DNA amplified by MDA (REPLI-g Single Cell Kit). Libraries are sequenced on HiSeq. Copy number analysis, LOH detection, haplotype copy number analysis, and rearrangement detection from discordant read pairs are performed.

methods.name: Copy number analysis
methods.protocol_description: Arm-level copy number estimated from read depth, normalized to a diploid baseline. Haplotype copy number determined using heterozygous SNPs and haplotype phase inferred from hemizygous chromosomes.

methods.name: LOH detection
methods.protocol_description: Loss-of-heterozygosity detected by analyzing heterozygous site coverage; a heterozygosity coefficient is calculated to identify hemizygous regions.

methods.name: Chromosomal rearrangement detection
methods.protocol_description: Rearrangements detected from clusters of discordant read pairs with insert size >20 kb, requiring at least one primary discordant pair. Control chromosomes used to estimate background.
